headline: Leaning higher, but expect big swings
text: US futures are up today (S&P +1.47%, Nasdaq +2.15%), with Europe higher and Asia mostly up.
Helping: Europe, Asia, Copper, Stocks above 200-day. Weighing: 10-year yield, Gold, S&P 500 vs 200-day, VIX.

Expect a jumpy session: the VIX is high at 25.6, SPY options gamma is negative (dealers' hedging makes moves bigger). Gaps and reversals are common in these conditions, so a small early move says little.
Options price a typical day of about ±1.6% for the S&P 500 (about 7,067–7,299); historically about 82% of days stay inside that.
On past days with VIX between 25 and 30 and the VIX curve normal (since 1990, 318 days), the next session closed higher 54% of the time (all days: 54%), with a typical move of 0.9% (all days: 0.5%).

scenarios.text: If SPY breaks below 720 (call wall), selling can speed up.
If SPY gets back above 732 (gamma flip), moves tend to calm and dips get bought.
Yesterday's S&P 500 range was 7,211–7,271: a break of either end is the first real sign of direction.

tips: Size smaller than usual and use the “wrong if” level on every alert.
